default.notes: A visa from a Belizean consulate is required before travel. Holders of a valid multiple-entry US visa are generally exempt, and some travellers can arrange clearance to pay the visa fee on arrival — confirm with the Belize Immigration Department.

groups.notes: No visa needed — visitors are stamped in for up to 30 days and can extend monthly at an Immigration office (BZD 100 per month for the first six months).

BZ.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Belizean citizens.

CN.notes: Belize recognises Taiwan rather than the People's Republic of China, so applications are handled by consulates outside the mainland and clearance can be slow. A valid multiple-entry US visa generally removes the visa requirement.
